_comment: Supply-chain pin for the @kohaku-eth privacy plugins and their transitive @kohaku-eth/provider transport wrapper. Versions and sha512 integrity hashes are mirrored verbatim from package-lock.json (the authoritative npm pin). This file is a human-auditable, single-screen summary so a reviewer can diff plugin versions across releases without parsing the full lockfile. npm enforces the hashes at `npm ci`; the bridge dynamic-imports each plugin lazily and only when its plugin is enabled via LEANCLI_PRIVACY. See docs/PLUGIN_ARCHITECTURE.md.

@kohaku-eth/railgun.note: Railgun shielded flow; dynamic-imported only on shielded.railgun.*

@kohaku-eth/privacy-pools.note: Privacy Pools shielded flow; dynamic-imported only on shielded.* (non-railgun)

@kohaku-eth/tornado-cash.note: Tornado Cash shielded flow; dynamic-imported only on shielded.tornado.*. Requires @kohaku-eth/plugins@0.0.1-alpha.11 (async Host) — nested privately under this package so railgun/PP keep plugins@0.0.1-alpha.8 (sync Host). See tornado-plugins-version-split note in docs/PLUGIN_ARCHITECTURE.md.

@kohaku-eth/mimc-tree.note: MiMC merkle tree used by tornado-cash; requires Node >=22.13 (bumps sidecars/kohaku engines floor)

@kohaku-eth/provider.note: transport wrapper (call/estimateGas proxy to client.request); top-level + nested under privacy-pools

@kohaku-eth/plugins.note: older plugins build pinned transitively under @kohaku-eth/privacy-pools
async-Host plugins build; nested under @kohaku-eth/tornado-cash only. Do NOT hoist to top level without migrating the railgun/PP sync hosts in bridge.mjs to async.
